evidence_hierarchy.exploratory: Outcome-specific panels and other cognitive/motor/Parkinsonism outcomes
evidence_hierarchy.primary: Control-derived Control-referenced AD-vs-Control all-edge standard-pruned connectivity
evidence_hierarchy.secondary: CT-specific/resolved, CogDx/three-class transfer, and full-cohort benchmarks

limitations: Repeated nested CV is internal validation conditional on fixed module definitions.
The historical 70/30 held-out cohort is previously inspected sensitivity data.
Diagnosis and CogDx are related outcomes, not independent replications.

global_cognition_exception.reason: global cognition was absent from the completed all-edge prediction catalog
global_cognition_exception.regularization_calibration: inner CV within each outer-training fold on all-edge scores

masked_sensitivity.regularization_source: matching fold-specific completed all-edge model; global cognition only uses outer-training all-edge calibration on the same frozen diagnosis-derived panel
